name: verdant
description: VERDANT — a top-down auto-shooter set in an overgrown space station.

scripts.release: node tools/build.mjs && node tools/build.mjs --portal=crazygames && rm -f verdant-web.zip verdant-crazygames.zip && (cd dist && zip -qr ../verdant-web.zip . -x '.*') && (cd dist-crazygames && zip -qr ../verdant-crazygames.zip . -x '.*')
scripts.test: for f in tests/*.test.mjs; do node "$f" || exit 1; done
